title: calculate_retirement_savings
description: Calculates retirement savings contributions, catch-up eligibility, and a projected balance at retirement. Returns monthly 401(k) and IRA contributions, employer match totals, tax implications, and a year-by-year projection with compound growth.

age.description: Current user age in years. Age ≥ 50 enables 401(k) and IRA catch-up contributions.

years_to_retirement.description: Number of years until the user plans to retire. Used for balance projection.

filing_status.description: Federal filing status. Affects traditional IRA deductibility phase-outs.

state.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation or 'no_state_tax'. Used for net income calculations.

contribution_percent.description: 401(k) contribution as a percentage of gross salary (0–100). Ignored if max_out_401k is true.

max_out_401k.description: When true, contributes the IRS annual maximum to the 401(k) regardless of contribution_percent.

employer_match_percent.description: Employer 401(k) match as a percentage of gross salary (e.g., 3 for a 3% match).

ira_contribution.description: Annual IRA contribution in USD. Cannot exceed IRS annual limit ($7,000; $8,000 age 50+).

ira_type.description: IRA account type. Traditional may be deductible (pre-tax); Roth is always after-tax.

expected_annual_return.description: Expected average annual investment return as a decimal (e.g., 0.07 for 7%). Used for balance projection only.

annual_401k_limit.description: Annual IRS 401(k) limit for the user's age.

annual_ira_limit.description: Annual IRS IRA limit for the user's age.

is_maxing_401k.description: Whether the user is maxing out the 401(k).

is_catch_up_eligible.description: Whether the user is eligible for catch-up contributions (age ≥ 50).

traditional_ira_deductible.description: Whether the traditional IRA contribution is tax-deductible.

traditional_ira_phase_out_warning.description: Whether the user's income is within the traditional IRA phase-out range.

hsa_eligible.description: Whether HSA contributions are eligible in this profile.

projected_balance_at_retirement.description: Estimated total retirement balance at retirement, including compound growth.

growth_rate_used.description: Expected annual return used in the projection.

years_to_retirement.description: Years used to produce the projection.
